t: These Site Veloso Waterproof Safety Boots deliver reliable foot protection and dry comfort for trade professionals working on demanding construction sites or in wet outdoor environments. Engineered with a durable leather upper and a waterproof, breathable membrane lining, these black boots keep feet dry while allowing moisture to escape. A robust steel toe cap protects against 200-joule impacts, and the steel penetration-resistant midsole guards against sharp underfoot hazards. The wide-fit design features a padded collar, padded tongue, and a cushioned polyurethane foam insole to ensure all-day comfort during long shifts.
